source.title: World and Continental Championship Locations (July 2020)
source.content:
It is with great pleasure that we announce the winning candidates to host the upcoming World Championship 2021 and Continental Championships 2022:

World Championship 2021 will be held in Almere, Netherlands.
Asian Championship 2022 will be held in Semey, Kazakhstan.
European Championship 2022 will be held in Copenhagen, Denmark.
North American Championship 2022 will be held in Toronto, Canada.

An additional thank you to the applicants from Vladivostok, Russia for their submission for the World Championship. You can view the application documents for the World Championship [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16COjhWLQSkqwNuZrHNR_P5Ee5rK61TCI?usp=sharing) and for the Continental Championships [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BWbeGD9W9dn4AMCRRiqGkW0D754P2I7a?usp=sharing).

translation.title: 世界及大洲锦标赛举办地公布（2020 年 7 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地公布 2021 年世界锦标赛及 2022 年大洲锦标赛的成功申办方：

2021 年世界锦标赛将在荷兰阿尔梅勒举办。

2022 年亚洲锦标赛将在哈萨克斯坦塞梅伊举办。

2022 年欧洲锦标赛将在丹麦哥本哈根举办。

2022 年北美洲锦标赛将在加拿大多伦多举办。

同时感谢俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克团队提交世界锦标赛申请。世界锦标赛申办材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16COjhWLQSkqwNuZrHNR_P5Ee5rK61TCI?usp=sharing)查看，大洲锦标赛材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BWbeGD9W9dn4AMCRRiqGkW0D754P2I7a?usp=sharing)查看。
